title: Discover Bank (legacy) customer uses Zelle / Bill Pay / transfers and is converted to Capital One 360
persona: Discover Cashback Debit customer awaiting conversion
customer_goal: Keep paying people and bills through the Discover-to-Capital One transition

governance.access_policy: Public-source competitive intelligence; legal review before external sharing

moments.title: Discover.com banner: 'Discover is part of Capital One'; customers told…
moments.frontstage: Product-by-product conversion: checking -> 360 Checking; money market -> 360 Performance Savings; savings stays savings; CDs stay CDs

fail_points.text: Legacy Discover money-movement help content has been removed from public web, leaving customers reliant on in-session help

moments.title: Pre-conversion Discover journeys (still governed by live Discover…
moments.customer_action: Pre-conversion Discover journeys (still governed by live Discover agreements): Zelle on Cashback Debit/Personal Checking — $600/day send, cancel until recipient enrolls, personal use only, Zelle tags; Bill Pay ('Deliver by Date', eBills, Repeating Payments; cancel electronic until 'In-Process'); ACH transfers to external accounts; outgoing wires requested in Account Center ('Transfer' > Wire Transfer), the Discover App ('Transfer' icon > Wire Transfers) or by paper Wire Transfer Form, with multi-level verification (authentication code / ID + selfie / notarized form / card security code), 3 p.m. ET cutoff and a $30 Outgoing Wire Transfer charge (DAA effective 2026-10-08); incoming wires via 1-800-347-7000 instructions, 4 p.m. ET posting cutoff; Add Cash at retailers ($20 min, $1,000 per transaction and per 24 h; $999.99 in AZ/NM).
moments.frontstage: Bill Pay limits $1-$5,000 (newer) / $10,000 (older) per payment; $20,000 per deliver-by date

moments.title: On conversion: account number unchanged, routing number changes;…
moments.frontstage: Conversion page 'What to expect': same account number, new Capital One routing number; 'Scheduled checks, transfers scheduled through Discover and direct deposits will still be completed'; 'Any eligible external accounts, joint account holders or beneficiaries will be set up for you'; 'Continue to send and receive Zelle® payments with your Capital One account'; direct deposits still up to 2 days early on checking; wires to the old routing number are returned; third-party apps (PayPal, Venmo, Robinhood) must be relinked per migrated product via Security > 'Linked Apps'.
moments.decision: Existing Capital One login vs new

fail_points.text: Customers with multiple Discover accounts converting at different times need a separate Capital One username per wave

moments.title: Zelle available on converted 360 Checking after accepting terms…
moments.frontstage: Zelle available on converted 360 Checking after accepting terms ($3,000/day, $12,500/month); Bill Pay available on checking (not savings); early paycheck replaces Early Pay on checking; Cashback Debit rewards end with a 12-month rewards true-up deposit

fail_points.text: Loss of debit rewards; Early Pay dropped on savings

moments.title: Money can still move between Capital One and Discover bank accounts…
moments.customer_action: Money can still move between Capital One and Discover bank accounts during the transition (internal/ACH); AutoSave notes Discover-to-Capital One transfers may take longer

moments.title: Discover platform maintenance (e.g., Nov 8 2026 1-8 am ET) suspends…
moments.frontstage: Discover platform maintenance (e.g., Nov 8 2026 1-8 am ET) suspends online/app/phone and may decline debit; Discover fraud line 1-877-737-1931; Capital One general 1-877-383-4802

moments.title: Discover accounts: Discover.com/app/1-800-347-7000; converted accounts:…
moments.frontstage: Discover accounts: Discover.com/app/1-800-347-7000; converted accounts: Capital One channels

status_tracking.where: Discover app until conversion; Capital One app after

exceptions.trigger: Wire sent to old Discover routing number after conversion
Discover customer needs to send a wire before conversion
exceptions.customer_experience: Request in Account Center ('Transfer' > Wire Transfer), the Discover App ('Transfer' icon > Wire Transfers) or by paper Wire Transfer Form; pass multi-level verification (authentication code, ID + selfie, notarized form or card security code); $30 outgoing charge; 3 p.m. ET cutoff
exceptions.bank_handling: Discover 'reserve[s] the right to verify or authenticate (or further verify or further authenticate) any request… There may be more than one level of verification'; non-compliant wires are returned
exceptions.resolution: Processed same business day if fully verified by 3 p.m. ET; after conversion the customer uses Capital One 'Wire Money' and the new routing number

assessment: Discover's standalone money-movement journeys are effectively being sunset in favor of Capital One 360; the public documentation gap during the transition is itself a finding.
